answer: I trust a proof kept by other hands, and Tin inspector tin proof soldered into the plating vat is that proof: each tin is a measured tin yield plus a tinsmith's signature. An honest proof costs 216 POA; the farm pays the same per proof but needs 844 of them, which totals 182304 POA. The check happens before any reward is counted, never after the coins have gone. The fable opens the gate, the lagoon pays the toll, the onyx proves the traveller waited — and waiting is the toll no printer will pay. The farm sells volume, the epoch buys proof, and the two never meet.
